alt.zh-CN: 头像图片或文字的替代文本。
alt.en-US: Alternative text for the avatar image or text.

border.zh-CN: 显示额外边框，可配置颜色和动画。
border.en-US: Additional border, with optional color and animation.

bottomSlot.zh-CN: 底部标记的形状、背景色、文字颜色、类名和样式字符串；内容使用 bottomSlotText snippet，`render` 为 snippet 时完全自定义标记。
bottomSlot.en-US: Shape, background color, text color, class and style string of the bottom badge; use the bottomSlotText snippet for its content. A `render` snippet replaces the whole badge.

bottomSlotText.zh-CN: 预设底部标记中的文字或节点的 snippet。
bottomSlotText.en-US: Snippet for the text or nodes inside the preset bottom badge.

children.zh-CN: 头像的文字或自定义内容的 snippet。
children.en-US: Snippet for the avatar text or custom content.

color.en-US: Preset background color of the avatar.

contentMotion.zh-CN: 启用头像内容区域的动画。
contentMotion.en-US: Enables animation in the avatar content area.

gap.zh-CN: 字符内容与头像左右两侧的间距，单位为像素。
gap.en-US: Space in pixels between the text and either side of the avatar.

hoverMask.zh-CN: 悬停时显示的覆盖层的 snippet，自行设置样式。
hoverMask.en-US: Snippet for the overlay shown on hover, with styles supplied by the caller.

imgAttr.zh-CN: 传给内部 img 元素的原生属性。
imgAttr.en-US: Native attributes applied to the inner img element.

onError.zh-CN: 图片加载失败时调用，返回 false 阻止默认回退。
onError.en-US: Called when the image fails to load. Return false to prevent the default fallback.

onMouseEnter.en-US: Called when the pointer enters the avatar.

onMouseLeave.en-US: Called when the pointer leaves the avatar.

shape.zh-CN: 头像形状，可选 circle 或 square。

size.zh-CN: 头像尺寸，支持预设名称或合法 CSS 尺寸。
size.en-US: Avatar size, as a preset name or a valid CSS size.

srcSet.zh-CN: 图片头像的响应式资源集合。

topSlot.zh-CN: 顶部标记的渐变色、文字颜色、类名和样式字符串；内容使用 topSlotText snippet，`render` 为 snippet 时完全自定义标记。
topSlot.en-US: Gradient, text color, class and style string of the top badge; use the topSlotText snippet for its content. A `render` snippet replaces the whole badge.

topSlotText.zh-CN: 预设顶部标记中的文字或节点的 snippet。
topSlotText.en-US: Snippet for the text or nodes inside the preset top badge.

item.zh-CN: 每个头像内容的 snippet，参数为 `{ item, index }`，优先于数据项自带的 `children`。
item.en-US: Snippet for the content of every avatar, with the parameter `{ item, index }`; it takes precedence over the item's own `children`.

items.zh-CN: 组内头像的数据，每项是 Avatar 的属性；组的 `size`、`shape` 覆盖数据项自己的。
items.en-US: Data of the avatars in the group; each item holds the props of an Avatar, and the group's `size` and `shape` override the item's own.

maxCount.zh-CN: 显示的最大头像数，超出后显示 +N。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of visible avatars; overflow is shown as +N.

more.zh-CN: 自定义溢出标签的 snippet，参数为 `{ restNumber, restAvatars }`：剩余数量与被隐藏的数据项。
more.en-US: Snippet for a custom overflow label, with the parameter `{ restNumber, restAvatars }`: the remaining count and the hidden items.

overlapFrom.zh-CN: 头像重叠方向，可选 start 或 end。
overlapFrom.en-US: Avatar overlap direction: start or end.

shape.en-US: Shape of the avatars in the group.

size.en-US: Size of the avatars in the group.
